newsitem.title: FRANCE: French opinion poll due in Swiss paper May 22.
newsitem.headline: French opinion poll due in Swiss paper May 22.

text.p: A CSA opinion poll of French voters' intentions in the May 25/June 1 parliamentary election is due to appear in Swiss newspaper Tribune de Geneve from 1700 GMT on May 22, an official at polling organisation CSA said on Friday.
Under French law it is forbidden for opinion polls to be published in France the week before a parliamentary election or in the week between the two rounds of voting.
The internet address for Tribune de Geneve is www.edicom.ch/tdg/.
At least two polls of voters' intentions will be released on Saturday, the final day results can be published in France.

A BVA poll for Europe 1 radio, France 2 television and weekly Paris Match will be released at 1600 GMT. A Sofres poll for TF1 television will be released at 1800 GMT, officials at the respective polling organistions said on Friday.
Officials at Louis Harris and IFOP were not immediately available for comment.
IPSOS, which published a poll on Thursday, said it would not be releasing any more poll results.
Most polling organisations said they will be conducting private polls during the coming two weeks but will not be making the results public.
